text:
Which statement about a magnet is correct?
A
A magnet attracts a gold rod.
B
A magnet does not attract a plastic rod.
C
A magnet never repels another magnet.
D
A magnet sometimes repels an unmagnetised nickel rod.

options.label: A
options.text: A magnet attracts a gold rod.

options.label: B
options.text: A magnet does not attract a plastic rod.

options.label: C
options.text: A magnet never repels another magnet.

options.label: D
options.text: A magnet sometimes repels an unmagnetised nickel rod.
